newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post front page - Feb 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post front page - Feb 25.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Feb. 25:
WASHINGTON - Virginia unveiled a plan to overhaul public schools with tougher graduation requirements and a strong focus on basic subjects.
WASHINGTON - As of Saturday, the National Park Service will ban people from bringing alcoholic drinks to downtown federal parks and will limit sales by vendors.

NEW YORK - The Palestinian English teacher who shot seven sightseers at the Empire State Building bought his semiautomatic pistol in a Florida gun shop the same day he obtained a state residence card.
WASHINGTON - The U.S. Food and Drug Administration approved use of high doses of birth control pills as an emergency contraceptive.
WASHINGTON - The Democratic National Committee is prepared to return dozens of additional political contributions that were questioned in a still-confidential audit of party fund-raising.
BEIJING - Deng Xiaoping was cremated Monday after China's top leaders paid him traditional homage at the military hospital where his body had lain since his death last Wednesday.
